steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In December 2022, Equity Mates noted McDonald’s tested the Beyond Meat McPlant burger, while other chains trialled rivals, showing major fast food interest in plant-based options.

episode.title: The 5 stupidest arguments against a gas price cap

views.text: In April 2022, Equity Mates said Beyond Meat emerged as a market leader as restaurants lined up to add plant-based items, amid forecasts that meat substitutes could be worth hundreds of billions by 2040.

episode.title: Is plant-based meat just a fad?

views.text: In January 2022, Equity Mates explained Beyond Meat made plant-based versions of beef, chicken, pork and sausages aiming to taste, cook and feel like meat, citing a University of Michigan study showing a Beyond Burger used 99% less water, 93% less land and 46% less energy than beef.

episode.title: Is this the taste of the future of food? - Beyond Meat | Summer Series

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In March 2023, Equity Mates contrasted plant-based firms like Beyond Meat with fast-improving lab-grown meat, noting a lab-grown beef patty’s cost fell from US$330,000 in 2013 to under US$10, raising competitive pressure on plant-based incumbents.

episode.title: From $330,000 to $10: Lab-grown meat is coming to a plate near you

views.text: In November 2022, an adviser on Equity Mates said they avoided investing in Beyond Meat because it had a bad business model, emphasising that they sought businesses making money rather than relying on positive impact alone.

episode.title: Expert: Steven Glass - Balancing growth & value with sustainable investing

views.text: In January 2022, Equity Mates described intense competition for Beyond Meat, with Impossible Foods and big consumer brands like Kellogg’s, Nestlé and Oatly offering similar products, challenging long-term pricing power.

episode.title: Is this the taste of the future of food? - Beyond Meat | Summer Series

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In June 2023, Equity Mates recalled Beyond Meat’s 2019 IPO sparked a plant-based boom, with the share price tripling within a month or two, showing how much hype was priced in.

In January 2022, Equity Mates linked a roughly 250 percent post-IPO jump to excitement over partnerships with McDonald’s, Yum, PepsiCo and others, and urged separating real traction from launch hype when considering the stock.

episode.title: Is this the taste of the future of food? - Beyond Meat | Summer Series
